meta.description: Pilot triage dataset cho W3GoAudit — 2 pattern thí điểm với nhãn ground truth do con người xác nhận.

labels.TP: True Positive — lỗi thật, xác nhận bởi audit report hoặc EVM test
labels.FP: False Positive — cảnh báo sai, đã có guard hoặc không thỏa sufficient condition
labels.Uncertain: Không đủ context để quyết định (thiếu caller/modifier/state)

meta.note: Synthetic cases được đánh dấu fixture_kind='synthetic'. Real cases lấy từ evidence_benchmark_v1.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm record() cast uint256 → uint128 trực tiếp không có guard. Khi amount = 2^128 sẽ bị truncate thành 0, vi phạm invariant 'reserve phải bằng giá trị đầu vào'.
cases.finding_title: UnsafeReserve: Silent overflow when casting large reserve amount
cases.finding_content: The `record(uint256 amount)` function stores user-provided `amount` directly into `reserve` which is of type `uint128`. When `amount` exceeds `2^128 - 1`, the cast silently truncates the high bits, causing `reserve` to store an incorrect value. There is no check before the cast.
cases.context_notes: No modifiers. No callers visible in snippet. Function is public.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Có guard `require(amount <= type(uint128).max)` trước cast. Mọi giá trị vượt ngưỡng sẽ revert, không xảy ra silent overflow.
cases.finding_title: GuardedReserve: Casting with explicit bound check (flagged by rule, actually safe)
cases.finding_content: The `record(uint256 amount)` function casts uint256 to uint128. Static rule flags this as potential narrowing overflow.
cases.context_notes: Guard exists immediately before cast. Function reverts on out-of-range. Rule fires but safe.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Fragment nội bộ không thấy caller. Có thể caller đã guard trước khi gọi hàm này, hoặc không. Không đủ context để kết luận.
cases.finding_title: UnknownFragment: Internal function with uint128 cast, no caller visible
cases.finding_content: An internal function casts uint256 to uint128. Cannot determine if the caller validates the input range before invoking this function.
cases.context_notes: Internal function. No callers shown in snippet. Need to inspect all call sites to determine safety.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Finding được xác nhận bởi Code4rena audit report. virtualBaseTokenReserves và virtualNftReserves là uint128, update bằng uint256 value mà không check overflow.
cases.finding_title: [H-03] Risk of silent overflow in reserves update — Caviar
cases.finding_content: However, these two variables are of type `uint128`, while the values that update them are of type `uint256`. This means that casting to a lower type is necessary, but this casting is performed without first checking that the values being cast can fit into the lower type. As a result, there is a risk of a silent overflow occurring during the casting process.
cases.context_notes: Real finding from Code4rena. No guard before cast. Confirmed High severity.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Contract sử dụng SafeCast library từ OpenZeppelin, hàm toUint128() sẽ revert nếu overflow. Rule phát hiện cast nhưng không nhận ra SafeCast wrapper.
cases.finding_title: SafeCast usage flagged as narrowing — false alarm
cases.finding_content: The contract converts uint256 to uint128 in the reserve update function.
cases.context_notes: SafeCast.toUint128() reverts if value > type(uint128).max. Rule sees cast, not the library safety.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Cần xem protocol invariant: giá trị có thể bao giờ vượt 2^128 không? Nếu token là stablecoin với 6 decimals, max supply << 2^128 thì thực ra safe. Cần thêm thông tin về protocol design.
cases.finding_title: Reserve update with narrowing cast — safety depends on token economics
cases.finding_content: The pool stores reserves as uint128. The update function accepts uint256 input.
cases.context_notes: Safety depends on maximum possible token supply. If token has 6 decimals and max supply 10B, max value is 10^16 << 2^128. Need protocol docs to confirm.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm setFeeRecipient() không có bất kỳ modifier kiểm tra quyền nào. Bất kỳ ai cũng có thể gọi và thay đổi fee recipient.
cases.finding_title: Missing access control on setFeeRecipient — anyone can call
cases.finding_content: The `setFeeRecipient` function lacks any access control modifier. Any external address can call it to redirect protocol fees to an arbitrary address.
cases.context_notes: No modifier. No require statement. External visibility. Anyone can call.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm có modifier onlyOwner kế thừa từ Ownable. Rule không parse được inheritance chain, báo nhầm missing access control.
cases.finding_title: onlyOwner through inheritance — flagged but protected
cases.finding_content: The `setFeeRecipient` function appears to have no access control modifier in the function definition.
cases.context_notes: onlyOwner modifier clearly present. Rule might misparse or context might be partial snippet.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm không có modifier tường minh nhưng contract có custom access control có thể check ở constructor hoặc storage mapping. Cần xem toàn bộ contract.
cases.finding_title: Setter with no visible modifier — custom access pattern possible
cases.finding_content: The `updateConfig` function has no access control modifier in its definition.
cases.context_notes: Custom require-based check instead of modifier. Rule expects modifier pattern, misses require-based auth.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Protocol fee setter có thể gọi bởi bất kỳ ai. Attacker có thể redirect fee đến địa chỉ của mình.
cases.finding_title: Protocol fee recipient can be set by any caller
cases.finding_content: The `setProtocolFeeRecipient` function is missing access control, allowing any user to redirect protocol fee revenue to an arbitrary address.
cases.context_notes: No modifier. Emits event. Called externally. Confirmed access control issue.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm intentionally public vì đây là permissionless protocol — bất kỳ ai cũng được phép update theo design. Đây là feature không phải bug.
cases.finding_title: Permissionless update — by design, not a vulnerability
cases.finding_content: The `syncPrice` function can be called by anyone to update the price oracle.
cases.context_notes: Protocol design: permissionless sync is intentional for liveness. Not a vulnerability.

cases.ground_truth_reason: Hàm có timelock nhưng không rõ timelock delay là bao nhiêu. Nếu delay < 24h thì vẫn có rủi ro. Cần xem cấu hình timelock.
cases.finding_title: Admin function behind timelock — safety depends on delay configuration
cases.finding_content: The function is gated behind a timelock contract. The security depends on the timelock delay value.
cases.context_notes: onlyTimelock modifier exists. Need to check if timelock delay is adequate (typically >= 24h for security).
